serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
CodeSignal is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for technical and non-technical skills evaluation and development. It provides pre-hire assessments delivered in a browser-based IDE, live collaborative technical interviews, AI-conducted screening interviews, behavioral and cognitive assessments, assessment proctoring and integrity services, experiential technical learning, and the integration, administration, reporting, identity, and API services that support them.

The offering is hosted on Amazon Web Services in the United States. Tenant data is logically segregated.

Customer data handled includes candidate, learner, and user PII (name, email address, IP address), assessment and learning content, submitted work, results, and, for the proctoring and integrity services, government-issued identity documents and session video. The offering does not process protected health information or cardholder data.

Several services use third-party foundation model subprocessors.
